title: 👀 Air Force One (25-3300) coming into sight: closest in about 1 min, look SSE, about 6° up, 11 mi away
body:

- **At its closest** (in about 1 min): look SSE (bearing 147°), about 6° above the horizon, 10.7 miles away, about 6,072 ft up
- **Right now:** S (bearing 184°), 13.6 miles away, about 7,267 ft above the farm's ground, heading NE, 320 kt
- **Callsign:** not broadcast; ICAO AF83F3

[ADS-B Exchange](https://globe.adsbexchange.com/?icao=af83f3) · [Farm receiver (farm network only)](http://192.168.1.190/tar1090/?icao=af83f3) · [Live map](https://rdbfarm.github.io/iad-map/live.html)

_Automatic alert from `pi/alerts.py`, once per visit. Its path is projected straight ahead at its present course, speed and climb or descent; it alerts only when that path is in sight (within 12 miles, at least 5° up) within 5 minutes for at least a minute. Those limits are estimates; a turn changes the path, and cloud isn't known._
